causal-factors.name: Definitive confirmation of Khamenei's death by multiple credible outlets (Feb 28–29, 2026)

causal-factors.name: Swift succession mechanism via Assembly of Experts

causal-factors.name: Death of Ali Khamenei (Feb 28, 2026)

causal-factors.rationale: Under Iran’s constitution, the 88-member Assembly of Experts must appoint a new supreme leader and can establish interim leadership, accelerating turnover toward a new office holder.

synthesis: Multiple credible outlets confirmed Khamenei's death in late February 2026, triggering a constitutionally defined succession process. Given the mechanism and historical precedent for turnover upon death, the probability of ceasing to be supreme leader before April 1, 2026 is effectively near-certain, consistent with the ensemble estimate.
